name: onebusaway-mcp-server
description: Query stops, routes, real-time arrivals, vehicle positions, and schedules from OneBusAway transit APIs via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

ONEBUSAWAY_API_KEY.title: OneBusAway API Key
ONEBUSAWAY_API_KEY.description: API key for the configured OneBusAway instance. Blank uses TEST on Puget Sound.

ONEBUSAWAY_BASE_URL.title: OneBusAway Instance URL
ONEBUSAWAY_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the OneBusAway instance. Blank uses Puget Sound.

ONEBUSAWAY_RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS.title: Requests per Rate Window
ONEBUSAWAY_RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS.description: Upstream requests allowed per window. Blank uses 20.

ONEBUSAWAY_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS.title: Rate Window (milliseconds)
ONEBUSAWAY_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS.description: Sliding rate-window duration. Blank uses 60000 milliseconds.

ONEBUSAWAY_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_MS.title: Maximum Queue Wait (milliseconds)
ONEBUSAWAY_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_MS.description: Longest queued wait for an upstream request. Blank uses 45000 milliseconds.

MCP_LOG_LEVEL.title: Log Level
MCP_LOG_LEVEL.description: Minimum log severity. Blank uses info.
